definition: Data Applied was a software vendor headquartered in Washington.
details: Founded by a group of former Microsoft employees, the company specialized in data mining, data visualization, and business intelligence environments.

explainer.lead: Data Applied was a Washington-based software company founded by former Microsoft employees. It worked across data mining, data visualization, and business intelligence, three activities that help organizations turn stored data into understandable information.

tiers.eli5: Imagine a shop with a huge box of receipts. Data Applied made the kinds of tools that could look through those receipts for patterns, turn the patterns into pictures, and help the shop owner make decisions. The company was started by people who had previously worked at Microsoft.
tiers.practitioner: Treat Data Applied as a software vendor rather than a data-mining technique. Its scope covered extracting patterns, visualizing results, and supporting business intelligence; do not infer particular algorithms, integrations, or performance characteristics from that description alone.
tiers.paperLevel: Data Applied denotes an organization, not a formal algorithm or mathematical model. Its technical scope can be summarized as the triple (data mining, data visualization, business intelligence), with no company-specific objective function or computational procedure implied.

explainer.example: A retailer could use this combination of capabilities to examine a year of sales records, identify a pattern such as increased umbrella sales on rainy days, and display that finding in a chart for business planning.

usedIn.name: Data mining
usedIn.detail: Discovering patterns in collections of data.

usedIn.name: Data visualization
usedIn.detail: Presenting data and analytical results as visual displays.

usedIn.name: Business intelligence
usedIn.detail: Using analyzed business data to support organizational decisions.

explainer.mission: Data Applied specialized in software for data mining, data visualization, and business intelligence environments. Its focus connected pattern discovery with ways to present and use the resulting information.
explainer.founded: The company was founded by a group of former Microsoft employees and was headquartered in Washington.
